# Click Indicators

> A practice mod for Geometry Dash 2.2, built on the Geode mod loader. It reads an
> input macro from a player who already beat a level and draws, in game, the exact
> frame you need to click on — then grades every press you make against that macro
> in frames. $2.99, one payment. Built by one person, jackz.

## What it actually does

- Loads a macro (a recorded input file) for a level and overlays a timing cue on your screen.
- Grades each press as a number of frames early or late, rather than "good" or "early".
- Five cue styles: Ring, Classic, Converge, Pulse, Highway. You pick whichever your eyes follow.
- The cue sits at one fixed offset you set yourself and does not drift between attempts.
- Practising from a Start Pos deep in a level stays in sync; the correction is measured
  from your own presses and remembered per spawn.
- Per-gamemode toggles (cube, ship, ball, UFO, wave, robot, spider, swing), so the guide can
  be switched off for modes where it gets in the way.
- Can blank the guide between any two percentages, to practise a section unaided.
- Works under speedhack: practise at 0.5x and the timing still lines up at 1x.
- Records your own runs, including in practice mode.
- Four sound packs: click, beep, wood, snap, with a separate tone for releasing a hold.

## Macro formats it reads

Silicate, GDR2, GDR, zBot, Mega Hack, ReplayBot, TASBOT, Echo, DDHOR, xBot, JSON.

## Requirements and limits

- Geometry Dash 2.2 with the Geode mod loader installed first.
- Windows, macOS and Android. There is no iOS build.
- Not distributed through the Geode mod index. You install it by putting the .geode file
  in `Geometry Dash/geode/mods` yourself.
- One device at a time. Signing in on another machine moves the licence and signs the old one out.
- All sales are final; there are no refunds.

## What it is not

It is a practice tool, not a bot and not a cheat. It does not send inputs, change physics,
or talk to the game's servers — it draws an overlay and measures presses you made yourself.
It should be switched off for a verification attempt.
